label: automatic-sync-default-paymentintents
content:
# Makes automatic async the default capture method for PaymentIntents when not specified

## What’s new

[PaymentIntents](https://docs.stripe.com/api/payment_intents.md?api-version=2024-06-20) now has `automatic_async` as the default capture method when capture method isn’t specified during PaymentIntents creation.

## Impact

Setting `automatic_async` as the default capture method for PaymentIntents when not explicitly specified lets you benefit from asynchronous capture by default, potentially improving payment success rates and reducing declines. To learn more, see our [guide](https://docs.stripe.com/payments/payment-intents/asynchronous-capture.md).

## Upgrade

#### REST API

1. [View your current API version](https://docs.stripe.com/workbench/guides.md#view-api-versions) in Workbench.
2. If you use an SDK, upgrade to the corresponding SDK version for this API version.
- If you don’t use an SDK, update your [API requests](https://docs.stripe.com/api-versions.md#how-versions-are-specified-in-requests) to include `Stripe-Version: 2024-04-10`
3. Upgrade the API version used for [webhook endpoints](https://docs.stripe.com/webhooks/versioning.md).
4. [Test your integration](https://docs.stripe.com/testing.md) against the new version.
5. If you use Connect, [test your Connect integration](https://docs.stripe.com/connect/testing.md).

Learn more about [Stripe API upgrades](https://docs.stripe.com/upgrades.md).
